cards.title: Droid Racks (V)
issues: Missing clause: 'Where Are Those Droidekas?! ignores Neimoidians.'

review.fix_instructions: Add a ModifyGameTextModifier on Where Are Those Droidekas?! with a new ModifyGameTextType (precedent: Card217_025 WAT_TAMBOR__IGNORED_BY_WHERE_ARE_THOSE_DROIDEKAS) and make the Droidekas cards (1250_24 from PR 553, plus 13_097/1114_033/208_042) exclude Neimoidians from their 'all your characters at sites are destroyer droids' check when modified. Add a test with a Neimoidian at a site.
review.notes: Deploy on Invasion, stack just-lost destroyer droid, 2-Force control-phase recycle, self-loss condition all implemented and tested. Legacy Where Are Those Droidekas?! is PR 553 (1250_24).

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on Invasion. Where Are Those Droidekas?! ignores Neimoidians. If your destroyer droid was just lost, may stack it here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to place any destroyer droid here in Used Pile. If your vehicle or character (except a Neimoidian or destroyer droid) at a site, this Effect lost. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: The Trade Federation utilizes such efficient methods of droid deployment that it is rumored even they do not know exactly how many battle droids are in circulation
pc_front.title: •Droid Racks (V)

cards.title: Hutt Influence (V)
issues: Missing clause: "'Imperial' on Human Shield may be treated as 'bounty hunter'."

review.fix_instructions: Add a ModifyGameTextModifier on Human Shield (Card5_145) with a new ModifyGameTextType and have Human Shield accept bounty hunters where it says Imperial when modified; add a test.
review.notes: Pit deploy, ISEWYD-gated BH forfeit +2 and Goo Nee Tay immunity, once-per-game All Wrapped Up upload are fine.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on a pit. 'Imperial' on Human Shield may be treated as 'bounty hunter'. While I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die on table, bounty hunters are forfeit +2 and immune to Goo Nee Tay. Once per game, if Nal Hutta on table, may take All Wrapped Up into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: Jabba's criminal empire extends to all reaches of the Outer Rim.
pc_front.title: •Hutt Influence (V)

cards.title: Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
issues: Missing Dark clause: "'Free' on You're A Slave? is treated as '2 Force.'"

review.fix_instructions: Add a ModifyGameTextModifier on You're A Slave? (new ModifyGameTextType) so its 'free' cost becomes 2 Force while this Dark text is active, and handle it in the You're A Slave? card; add a test.
review.notes: Doubling, Light once-per-game reduce to zero, Endor Shield cancel, Revolution immunity fine.

pc_front.gametext: Dark: 'Free' on You're A Slave? is treated as '2 Force.' Your Force loss from You're A Slave? is doubled. Light: Endor Shield is canceled. Once per game, may reduce Force loss from You're A Slave? to zero. Immune to Revolution.
pc_front.title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
